name: feature-marker
author: Vinicius Carvalho
description: Native-adapter feature workflow CLI for Claude, Codex, and Gemini with isolated worktrees, neutral checkpoints, tests, and branch-only handoff.
longDescription: Feature Marker runs a CLI-owned feature workflow across Claude, Codex, and Gemini adapters. It keeps PRD, TechSpec, and Tasks under tasks/{slug}, stores checkpoints and logs under .feature-marker/features/{slug}, creates isolated worktrees under .feature-marker/worktrees/{slug}, and finishes with a clean committed branch plus handoff commands instead of pushing or opening PRs automatically.
